$comment: Burn-down list for webpet skips. scripts/webpet/skip-gate.js fails the run for any
skipped or didNotRun test NOT matched here, so a skip can never quietly become
permanent. Every entry needs a reason and a ticket/work-item; entries that stop
matching are reported as stale so this file shrinks over time.
`match` is a testCaseId (WP-0308), a title substring, a file substring, or a
skip-reason substring (the string passed to test.skip()/test.fixme()).

allow.match: is disabled in its runner row
allow.reason: Runner-manager-disabled tests (enabled=0 in webpetRunnerManager.csv) skip at runtime with this reason. The CSV is the system of record for these: every disabled row carries its own notes and jira columns, enforced by webpet:runner:check — duplicating each id here would just drift. This entry keeps the gate green for documented disables while any OTHER skip still fails it.

Same runner-disabled path as above, but for a test with no testCaseId annotation (the structural-key fallback in webpetGate.ts wording). Cannot fire today — all 406 tests are annotated — kept so an unannotated disable never surprises the gate.

scan-time-in-equivalence is deliberately env-gated (SCAN_TIME_IN_EQUIV=1 + SCAN_EMPLOYEE_BARCODE) so no employee barcode is hardcoded into the repo. It skips by design everywhere those vars are unset, including CI.

Reconcile Job Cards tests self-gate on a per-client preference. Dev has it off, so the populated-grid branch cannot be exercised. Complementary tests cover the off-branch, so this is conditional coverage rather than lost coverage — but the gating question itself is open (see the reconcile ticket draft: accounting.export is granted yet the sidebar link is absent).
Mirror of the above — the banner branch only runs where the preference is ON. One of this pair always skips by design.

allow.match: No JobCards in the last 30 days
allow.reason: Populated-grid branch needs recent Job Cards on the environment. Genuine data dependency — candidate for the data-factory treatment (create a Job Card, assert, delete) the way parent-picker.spec.ts now works.
allow.ticket: WORK-ITEM: own Job Card data in reconcile spec

allow.reason: Board-badge tests need seeded boards; dev has none.
allow.ticket: WORK-ITEM: seed or create boards in-test

allow.reason: The /boards endpoint is absent on this deployment, so the spec cannot set up its own data either.
Pack House scan screen not built yet — test authored acceptance-first ahead of the feature.

WEBPET-905 closed Done, but what shipped is device/server-side verification — reconfirmed 2026-08-23: the deployed web bundle has no capture/verify surface (every "fingerprint" hit is the Sentry SDK) and scanRoutes.ts records no scan-entry card. Stays deferred until a web-reachable surface exists.

allow.match: three Time In records and one Time Out record
allow.reason: Equivalence scenario blocked on scan-device/Time In setup that the spec cannot yet build for itself.

allow.match: no day in Time In carries 2+ rows
allow.reason: Added 2026-08-04 with the time-in day-discovery fix: the spec now finds a populated day from the API instead of hardcoding 2025-12-01, and skips with this reason only when the environment genuinely has no day with two rows to compare. Prefer creating the rows outright once an ensureTimeIn factory exists.

WP-0302 exercises the no-permission redirect branch, but the seeded su account always holds accounting.export on dev, so the negative branch is unreachable every run. Runs once a non-SU login exists for the suite (same account the WEBPET_NONSU entry below waits on).

allow.match: widgets removed from the editor flow
allow.reason: WP-0319 only: web-pet 219d5ac83 deliberately removed widgets from the editor flow (reconfirmed live 2026-08-23 — no Widgets entry anywhere); the filter-summary half of the old assertion moved into WP-0310.
